lead: A hostile case sized to prove a `Core\Str` call is constant-time hangs under `bun nv try` and the proofs runner, and the member is not the cause.
body: Both run a debug build, where `NvsStr::text_of` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/string.rs`) runs `debug_assert!(from_utf8(..))` over the whole payload on every read, so each call with a string argument is linear in its length there and O(1) in release. Size a long-string step so its calls times its length stays near 100 MiB, and time the release binary before calling a slowdown a finding.
